This is the question everyone in the cyber security area is trying to answer. Of course, yes. Thanks to AI, which is one of the most popular technologies in the information technology area, it is used in many areas ranging from e-commerce, advertising, human resource & recruiting, video games, transportation, surveillance systems etc. AI has been used in cyber security over the last years. Although it also has negative effects, we are going to mostly talk about its positive sides in this article. We are going to go deep into how and why AI is used in cyber security, how AI improves and enhances the current traditional cyber security methods. Then, we will also talk about which AI techniques play an important role in the cyber security area.

articleTitle: Voice-Based Virtual-Controlled Intelligent Personal Assistants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Virtual assistants are improving and providing consumers with greater advantages. The comprehension and fulfilment of requests by virtual assistants will increase as voice recognition and natural language processing continue to grow. Virtual assistants are projected to be employed in more commercial activities as speech recognition technology advances. The main goal of developing personal assistant software (virtual assistant) is to use web-based semantic data sources, user-generated content, and knowledge from knowledge libraries. Basically, main objective of making this Voice-Based Virtual Assistant is to make life easier and having a personal assistant to everyone which can perform many tasks. As the end user interacts with a virtual assistant, the AI programming learns from the data provided and improves its ability to forecast the end user's needs. Virtual assistants are often used to do things like add tasks to a calendar, provide information that would normally be found in a website, and operate and monitor Smart Home devices like lighting and cameras and thermostats. Massive volumes of data are required to fuel virtual assistant technologies, which feed Artificial Intelligence (AI) platforms such as machine learning, natural language processing, and speech recognition. Speech recognition has a lengthy history and has seen several key advancements. On smartphones and wearable devices, speech recognition for dictation, search, and voice commands has become a standard feature. Design of a small, large vocabulary speech recognition system that can run quickly, accurately, and with minimum latency on mobile devices.

articleTitle: A Review Paper on Automatic Number Plate Recognition using Machine Learning : An In-Depth Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques in Automatic Number Plate Recognition: Opportunities and Limitations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The recognition of license plates, known as Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR), is an important topic in the fields of smart transportation systems and image recognition. ANPR has the potential to significantly improve traffic control and safety measures in urban areas. Its primary objective is to automatically detect and recognize the characters on vehicle license plates using modern technology and image processing techniques. With the rapid increase in the number of vehicles, ANPR has become a crucial tool for traffic control and management. In recent years, ANPR technology has advanced significantly, leading to the development of protocols such as OCR, which enables the recognition of license plate locations and allows traffic surveillance to address various issues, such as criminal investigations, toll collection, speed control, and parking management. ANPR systems play a vital role in traffic control and surveillance, and several systems have been developed to recognize license plates, each with its specific advantages. The key steps involved in an ANPR system are the precise localization of the number plate, segmentation, and recognition. This paper presents an efficient and layout-independent ANPR system that can accurately detect and recognize license plates, thus enhancing traffic control and surveillance measures.

articleTitle: Future Communication Technology Using Huge Millimeter Waves—An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Frequency selective surface (FSS) was first created by G. Marconi and C. S. Franklin in 1919 and is known as the "Reflector for Wireless Telegraph and Telephone," making a significant contribution to our way of life. In terms of the 1960s, it is impossible to overlook the success attained with the employment of regularly selective surfaces in military intelligence units. These structures, which were occasionally applied to land, air, and sea platforms, displayed low pass, high pass, band pass, or band stop characteristics for particular frequencies and served as electromagnetic filters. Many accomplishments have been made, particularly with platforms that are invisible to target detection systems. The geometry and arrangement of the unit cell in these structures, which are successfully used in many fields such as wireless communication systems, radars, and microwaves, allows for the reflection or transmission of the incoming electromagnetic wave. This is made possible by the advancement of technology. High-speed internet connectivity is possible using millimeter wave, a frequency spectrum between 30 GHz and 300 GHz. Its significance has grown in the fields of radio astronomy, radar, remote sensing, and wireless communications.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Hostel Facility Automation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Hostel facility management system is a cloud based system was developed to automate hostel administration. The safety of their child is the top concern for parents who send their kids to hostels, whether it’s for college or for other purposes. The entire process might be digital to make things simpler to observe . It will check the cleaning status of rooms, allocate rooms to students online, and give additional capabilities that will increase transparency. It controls the database’s data and retrieves it as needed. The created solution supposedly addresses the shortcomings of manual hostel management and is undependable, user-friendly, and efficient. There will be usage of cloud and MongoDB technologies. In order to eliminate manual paperwork, this study is centeredon the development of a hostel automation system based on cloud computing. To reduce concurrency, all hostel activities will be administered on a single platform.

articleTitle: Loan Status Prediction in the Banking Sector using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: There have been tremendous advancements in technology that have led to an increase in the needs of people. This, in turn, has led to more loan approval requests in the banking sector. Some attributes are considered to check loan status while selecting an applicant for loan approval. Banks are facing a serious challenge when it comes to evaluating loan applications and mitigating the risks associated with borrowers potentially defaulting on their loans. This process is particularly laborious for banks, as they must thoroughly verify each individual's loan eligibility. This paper proposes utilizing machine learning models with Ensemble Learning Techniques to determine the viability of granting individual loan requests. By using this approach, it is possible to enhance the accuracy with which suitable candidates are selected from an existing list. Therefore, this process can be used to address the aforementioned concerns surrounding loan approval processes. The model is helpful to both bank staff and applicants as it drastically reduces the time taken to sanction the loan.

articleTitle: Bread and Bounty : Feel the Hunger Feed the Hungry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Food loss and waste have increased significantly over the past approximately ten years, putting the world’s population at risk of a developing food catastrophe in the coming century. This assessment of literacy is being done to see how much research is being done on waste and loss of food and what approaches are most frequently employed. Inside this study, we work to end hunger in society by providing for the underprivileged and utilising food in the right ways. However in the near, we could be able to transform food scraps into a useful and cost-effective energy source. Therefore, with the aid of our concept, we also hope to lessen food waste while serving as a source of recyclable energy and thereby improving the environment.

articleTitle: Network security, trust & privacy in a wiredwireless Environments–An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: In this report, we explore the key challenges and threats facing network security in wired and wireless environments, as well as the technologies and best practices for addressing these challenges. We provide an overview of the key concepts and terminology related to network security, trust, and privacy, and discuss the role of encryption in maintaining trust and privacy in these environments. We also examine common attack vectors and countermeasures and offer some recommendations for best practices in the realm of network security.

articleTitle: Multiple Replica Based Auditing of Outsourced Data: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Due to its wide range of services, the cloud has amassed a significant number of consumers in the current environment. Data owners can keep any kind of data on the cloud server, and users can access it whenever they need it. The simplicity of using data that has been outsourced comes with many difficulties. Outsourced data’s accuracy and confidentiality are at risk. Because cloud service providers occasionally lie, users have little faith in them. In order to evaluate and record the performance of their cloud vendor, a data owner conducts a cloud audit. Analyzing a cloud vendor’s compliance with a predetermined set of controls is the aim of the audit. This article explores numerous cloud auditing techniques, their classifications, advantages, and disadvantages. The main focus of the study is the exploration of Multiple replica-based studies and their performance evaluation. The article discusses the way ahead in the field of multiple replica-based auditing research.

articleTitle: An Intelligent and Effective Framework for Reduction of Diabetes Risk
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is characterized by a sedentary lifestyle, poor nutrition, and workplace stress, that could result in neurological damage, cardiovascular disease, seizures, renal failure, as well as other serious medical conditions. Hyperglycemia could be efficiently managed unless diagnosed early and accurately. Techniques based on machine learning (ML) are especially effective at predicting, but also detecting hyperglycemia later. This assignment would aim to investigate hypoglycemic episodes using supervised and unsupervised machine learning methods. From 2018 to 2022, studies on hyperglycemia treatment were included in the evaluation. Hyperglycemia has been forecasted overall incredible precision using judgment tree-based techniques such as Logistic Regression, SVM, XGBoost, AdaBoost, etc. Unmonitored learning methods like LDA and KMean could help with feature extraction as well as unique identification in huge datasets. As a hybrid model of supervised and unsupervised machine learning approaches, K-Mean and SVM have also been used to interpret and analyze hyperglycemia with great confidence.

articleTitle: Impact of Macroeconomic Indicators on the Indian Stock Market: A Study on NSE Nifty
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: It is impossible to overstate the importance of the financial sector to the economy. Since the economy of India has opened its gates to foreign direct investment (FDI), a lot of money has come into the country. This has influenced the stock market. This study examines the relationship between the prices of stocks and the key economic indicators for India. This analysis focuses on the effects of foreign direct investment (FDI) as a proportion of real gross domestic product (RGDP), money supply (M3) as a proportion of RGDP, gold price, exchange rate, and consumer price index (CPI) on the movement of the stock market (NSE Nifty). The CPI has frequently been used to assess a country's inflation rate. The analysis examines 36 quarters of data, beginning in 2012-2013 and ending in 2020-2021. To figure out what the data mean, the study used descriptive statistics, a test for normality, multiple regression analysis, and a chi-square test for goodness of fit. Specifically, there are two levels of analysis. In the first step, data from the 2012-2013 financial year to the 2019-2020 financial year were put through a process called multiple regression. The second step is to use the model to predict what will happen in 2020-2021 and then do a chi-squared test to see how accurate it is. NSE stock price was regressed on Foreign direct investment as a share of RGDP, money supply M3 as a share of RGDP, the exchange rate, the price of gold, and the consumer price index. Except for the CPI, all of the control factors have a negative effect on the price of NSE stock. This was found by using regression analysis. Other than the consumer price index and the exchange rate, however, none of the other indicators have a significant impact on the stock market. The adjusted R-squared statistic and the F-test show that the model is statistically important. Actual NSE stock prices for the first three quarters of 2020-21 are roughly what was expected, according to the chi square test.

articleTitle: Intelligent Food Recommendation System Based on Nutritional Information and Preferences of Customers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The growing concern for human being is about their health and resilience. People are unaware about their health conditions and what type of food they should eat in that health condition. People tend to overlook the internal structure of the food they eat and don’t pay attention to how many calories they should take in a day. This project motivates us to find out what food items and number of calories we should eat in various health conditions. This paper introduces a study of the food recommendation system. Foods can be grouped into categories based on calories, nutrients, price, vitamins, diseases, and other factors. Alternatively, restaurants can be identified based on distance from the user, price range, food offered, ratings and reviews. This paper highlights several parameters for food process making which is a very time-consuming process. A digital menu containing comprehensive information about food items. The digital menu will help customers to make decision on food very easily. This project includes a table booking service, recipes of food items, and food ordering service for the customers.

articleTitle: Deep Belief Network based Diabetic Maculopathy Detection and Classification using Modified Chicken Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: One of the most frequent causes of visual impairment in people with diabetes mellitus is diabetic maculopathy (DM). The macula is the important a part of the retina accountable for sharp vision. Diabetic maculopathy is a type of diabetic eye disease that affects the macula. The most prevalent and typical sign of diabetic maculopathy is diabetic macular edema(DME). In addition, people with diabetics one of the common cause for DME is visual impairment. Therefore, it is of the utmost important to detect DME region early and accurately. On the other hand, Ophthalmologists widely use optical coherence tomography (OCT) as an imaging tool to identify retinal diseases. In this paper, Chicken Swarm Optimization driven Deep Belief Network is developed for DME classification. In this method, OCT images are taken into account for the effective classification of the DME process. In this classification process, the layer segmentation stage involves segmenting 12 layers and 13 borders. Moreover, the Deep Belief Network classifier is applied in order to classify the images of OCT as normal one or DME affected region. The GAN classifier is trained by Chicken swarm algorithm such that the efficiency of classification is enhanced. This developed approach outperforms with other existing DME approach with respect to accuracy, specificity and sensitivity of 94.24%, 94% and 94% respectively.

articleTitle: Scope and Status of Artificial Neural Network based prediction models in Meteorology: From Backpropagation to Recurrent Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) have, since two decades, emerged as a powerful model for forecasting. Owing to its large scale success, the backpropagation model quickly attracted the attention of meteorologists across the world for forecasting various events. ANNs are statistical models which do not take into account the dynamics of the system while making predictions. Instead, they utilize the past records for discovering the underlying statistical relation between the predictors and the predictand. Researchers have always been interested in evaluating the forecasts made by the statistical models viz-a-viz those made with the state-of-the-art Coupled Global Circulation Models (GCMs). The accuracies of both the models have been found to be comparable. Comparisons among various statistical models have also been done at length. As the backpropagation algorithm based ANN models essentially perform non-linear regression, a competition between the two approaches has been the basis of many academic studies. Of late, ANNs have been improvised to behave like a quassi-dynamical forecast model by incorporating the feedback connections, the way GCMs do. Such networks are called the Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The developments in such designs and their incorporation in meteorology are in a nascent stage and conclusive evidence of their accuracies over the backpropagation networks are lacking. The present article shows the role played by the ANN based computational intelligent systems in meteorology in recent years. The prospects of the dynamically modeled ANN architecture, i.e. the Recurrent Network, are discussed for application in meteorology. Whether or not such incorporation would improve the prediction accuracies is a matter of investigation. On one hand the feedback connections do provide the historical dependence but on the other hand, in meteorological dynamics, chaotic aspects may come into picture and eventually limit the predictability. The results of propsed model shows very accurate in respect of other existing models with metrics MSE, RMSE and Speed. The complementary nature of statistical and dynamical models towards each other is also outlined in this article.

articleTitle: Text Generator using Natural Language Processing Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The field of NLP (Natural Language Processing) deals with the interaction between computers and human languages, focusing on the automated analysis of human language to extract useful information. For organisations that place a premium on efficiency, automation is the ultimate aim, and natural language processing is key to getting there. A machine can only completely comprehend humans when it talks with them in human language; it’s like speaking to someone in your mother tongue as opposed to someone you hardly understand or can barely speak. It is closed using natural language processing. . This paper will examine how a machine can truly comprehend human language while also delving into the specific algorithms that are employed. This essay will examine text conversions in-depth and go over how natural language processing proceeds. For those who are curious about the fundamentals of comprehending and mastering natural language processing, this review essay may be helpful. Natural language processing has a wide range of applications, including text processing, summarization, translation, voice and speech recognition, AI-powered user interfaces, expert systems, and more. However, Despite advances, NLP still faces challenges in accurately detecting emotions and expressions conveyed through non-verbal cues such as voice tone and body language. There are far too many difficulties in processing the complex linguistic system of humans. It will soon be necessary for everyone to communicate with a machine for both domestic and space-related tasks, making it crucial to comprehend how artificial intelligence works and how crucial NLP is to it.

Author Keywords: Natural language processing (NLP) encompasses techniques such as machine learning
and vectorization to process and understand human language

articleTitle: Medical care Robots and Their Utilizing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: With recent development in Drone technology and the conditions of traffic in our country a drone to provide instant first aid to an onsite accident as a measure of being the first responded wifi benefit multiple people in an emergency, thus deploying a drone to provide relief is the ideal choice and such is explored in the paper submitted.

articleTitle: Warning System with Face Mask Detection Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The main motive of writing this paper is to create a facial mask detector that can find whether a person has worn a facemask properly or not. This paper is used to solve real-life problems that nowadays we must avoid. So it helps any person. After implementing this detector, we can easily classify people who are wearing a face mask and the people who are not wearing the mask and people who are incorrectly wearing facemasks. The proposed method of this paper uses the YOLO algorithm. This detector can be used for precautionary purposes during the spread of COVID-19. The aim of this research paper is to propose an alert system that detects individuals not wearing masks in public places using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The proposed system uses a dataset of images to train the CNN model, which accurately identifies the presence or absence of a mask on a person's face. Live video feeds from cameras installed in public areas are monitored by the system, which sends alerts to authorities when it detects individuals not wearing masks. The effectiveness of the system is evaluated through experiments and comparison with other state-of-the-art face mask detection methods. This paper proposes a YOLO algorithm-based facial mask detector that can classify people who are wearing masks, those who are not, and those who are wearing masks incorrectly. The proposed method can be used for precautionary purposes during the spread of COVID-19 and has the potential to mitigate the spread of infectious diseases.

articleTitle: Human Emotion Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: As the world is developing, so are the needs to understand human emotional behavior in order to decrease the amount of crimes, increase the business sales and various medical purposes. This research paper tests the various algorithms present in today’s field which were used for human emotion recognition by which they achieve certain precision of understanding and recognizing the emotion of the human more correctly. Such systems attract lots of attention in the present world as this system will help the business grow and understand the present mood of their customers. The proposed system of Human Emotion Recognition (HER) consists of three very simple parts , the initial phase is face detection, second is feature extraction and finally recognition and output. Basically the system uses 3 layers of CNN as well as a system of OpenCV algorithms. The dataset which we used is of Keras but the color detection can be done through the Kaegal color model. The AAM (Active Appearance Model) method is used to extract and save various physical features and distance among them as a dataset to understand how faces change. Through understanding the Euclidean distance the output of pictures can be understood. The current recognition rate of this proposed system can be around 91% to 94%.Artificial Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) is used to further modify the model results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Conventional HPPT Techniques for Solar PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Energy plays a vital role to sustain our way of life. Over 80 percent of the energy consumed worldwide comes from fossil fuels. Because of this, fossil fuels are being depleted, and they are also bad for the environment. As a result, there is a growing interest in renewable resources. Solar systems, in particular, gain attention because of their endless energy supply, but their main limitations are their low output effectiveness and high equipment costs. A Photo-V cell can only transfer 5-20% of the sun radiation that it receives into electricity. Due to this, it is essential to distribute solar energy at the lowest cost and best efficiency. A successful photovoltaic (PV) generation system needs to have an efficient peak power tracking technique. An effective highest power point tracking (HPPT) method is required to boost the effectiveness of a photo-cell production scheme. The standard HPPT methods are thoroughly examined in this work for uniform sun irradiation and temperature circumstances. The performance of various approaches is evaluated in a comparison review in tabular form at the conclusion of each category's discussion, which will help you select the most useful option.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection, Classification and Counting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: According to logic, turnpike chiefs are becoming increasingly dependent on the differentiating evidence and counting of watchful automobiles. However, due to the wide range of vehicle sizes, discovery is still difficult, which affects the accuracy of the vehicle count. The review includes a further excellent thruway vehicle dataset with around 6000 clarified events in 12659 images. In contrast to existing publicly available datasets, the suggested dataset retains clarified tiny picture-related components, providing comprehensive information for deep learning-based vehicle detection. The proposed vehicle location and counting framework eliminates the parkway street surface from the image and divides it into a remote and proximal zone using a previously proposed division strategy; the method is essential for advancing vehicle discovery. Finally, video handling is used to obtain driving directions. A few parkway observation recordings from various scenes are used to validate the suggested procedures. Results from tests show how applying the suggested division technique might improve identification accuracy, especially for small vehicle items. Additionally, the original methodology described in this paper does a commendable job of determining driving route and counting automobiles. This paper has broad implications for the board and control of the Parkway Scene.

articleTitle: Computer-aided diagnosis Application by using Nonlinear Dynamics of EEG Signals to detect Depression State
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: In neurophysiology, nonlinear dynamics has been utilised to decode the intricate EEG brainwave patterns. In order to better understand the nonlinear nature of EEG data, numerous nonlinear approaches have been suggested and implemented recently. Nonlinear dynamics, a key mathematical subject that characterises the complex real-world phenomena characterised by nonlinear dynamics, has attracted significant interest in a wide range of scientific disciplines, including physics, chemistry, economics, electronics, and biomedical engineering, to name just a few. In this study, the authors explored how EEG waves may be detected using a computer to help in the diagnosis of depression. Depression is a mental illness that interferes with a person's ability to carry out normal, daily tasks. To lessen the burden on the sufferer and their loved ones, an accurate diagnosis of depression is crucial. Psychiatric disorders can be detected by the EEG's signal changes. As an objective, non-invasive method, the EEG has found widespread application in the study of numerous neurological conditions. But a CAD system is built to identify and analyse the subtle alterations in the signals. EEG signals, both normal and depressed, can be broken down into their component frequencies using the discrete cosine transform (DCT). DCT coefficients are used to assess the efficacy of nonlinear techniques such sample entropy, correlation dimension, fractal dimension, greatest Lyapunov exponent, Hurst exponent, and detrended fluctuation analysis. The t-value is used to rank the extracted characteristics. Classifiers are fed these relevant features. Accuracy achieved is 94.2 percent in classification together with 93.4 percent sensitivity and 95.6 percent specificity.

articleTitle: Securing Data in the Internet of Things (IoT) using Metamorphic Cryptography - A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) involves connecting a wide range of devices to the internet, allowing them to be controlled and monitored remotely. However, the transmission and storage of data in the IoT environment create security risks, including the possibility of unauthorized access or tampering. It is essential to use strong cryptographic and steganographic techniques to protect the confidentiality and integrity of this data. Cryptography involves using mathematical algorithms and protocols to encrypt and decrypt data to protect it from unauthorized access. Steganography is away to hide a message within another message or piece of data to keep it from being found. Their combined usage can help to secure IoT devices and ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the data transmitted and stored in them. This paper discusses the existing implementations of metamorphic cryptography to secure data in IoT devices.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Speech Emotion Recognition Models and Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) refers to accurately predicting human emotions from their speech. The ability to predict emotions through speech signals is a motivating factor in achieving Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). This paper contains a comparative study of the existing research on speech emotion models. It makes use of the RAVDESS and SAVEE dataset containing audio input. The study of speech emotion recognition is made on SVM, CNN, KNN, MLP, Decision Tree, XGBoost, and Random Forest models. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the models highlighting the accuracy, F1 Score, bar plots, and loss graphs of the same. The paper also highlights the significant future areas for study in speech emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform based Alzheimer’s Disease detection using Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a neurological, irreversible disorder of the brain that reduces the cognitive skills and memory ability. Alzheimer’s Disease should be diagnosed in initial phase for providing efficacious treatment to the patient. Delay in treatment may lead to the demise of patient. This paper presents a new technique for feature extraction in Alzheimer’s Disease classification. Dual Tree complex wavelet transform is applied to decompose the image into six sub images. Subsequently, Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix is calculated from six sub images. From these matrices 22 statistical features are obtained for each sub-band image. Further, Genetic Algorithm is used to obtain the relevant and optimum features to improve the classification accuracy. Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform shows high directional selectivity, so it can decompose the image from six different directions and provide additional informative features. In addition, Gray Level Co¬occurrence Matrix deals with the image intensity directly, so it provides the information related with the patterns which are mutually occurring. Genetic Algorithm requires less information and provides more solutions, so it extracts optimum features and improves classification accuracy. The proposed method obtained 96.2% accuracy, 96.4% sensitivity and 95.9% specificity. The performance of the proposed work surpasses the existing traditional approaches for AD detection.

articleTitle: An LSTM based Propaganda Detection System for News Articles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Social media has seen a tremendous rise in the past few years. Covering almost all demographics, it has expanded its reach to daily routine and is on the way to becoming an essential aspect of everyday life. Along with social media, the news is also transforming into its digital form. With the internet, it becomes even more readily available, and anyone can create and access it. With this much influence, digital news becomes heavily vulnerable to propaganda. Propaganda is a biased and misleading technique used to promote or publicize some cause, point of view, or perception toward a particular entity. The prime objective of propaganda is to influence public opinion by manipulating information. Digital news has become a popular tool for malicious entities, as it quickly reaches a broad spectrum of people and has prolonged effects. Propaganda in the news can take many forms, such as sensationalized headlines and articles, biased reporting, or false information being presented as fact. It can easily manipulate and mislead people, even if a factual event gets narrated ill-naturedly. Propaganda news is challenging to identify and can have damaging effects. Hence it becomes an important task to identify news that has propaganda. The existing works that deal with propaganda detection lack multi-granularity and suffer from downcast results. An effective technique is proposed in the bi-level propaganda detection system that works on the article and sentence level, integrated together, and is tested experimentally on a standard dataset that achieves maximum accuracy and F1-Score.

articleTitle: Intelligent Face Emotion Detection Application for Blind People
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Facial expressions are recognized by the various quality of the human face such as postures, emotions, and orientation of the face. As many people around us are visually impaired and suffer problems in detecting emotions of the human facial expressions. In this paper, we are implementing an application on the identification of facial expressions for blind people which helps visually impaired people to recognize facial expressions with a different sound on different expressions such as happy, anger, sad, disgust, fear, neutral, surprise, etc. Technologies such as image processing and computer vision are used in this application. The application of identification of facial expressions uses the camera to capture the expressions of the human face. It also detects the movements of eyes, nose, lips, etc., and analyzes by comparing with the trained data using classifiers to recognize the facial expressions of the human face and by using algorithms of machine learning, it converts expressions into sound based on different expressions so that blind people can recognize expressions of the human face.

articleTitle: A survey on classification of Geospatial Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Machine learning has become an essential component of issue resolution in the modern world, whether the challenge is small-scale, like estimating rent, or large-scale, like facial recognition. Clustering is one of the areas in which machine learning attempts are being made. Clustering is the process of organizing a collection of objects into groupings called "clusters," to put it simply.Pattern recognition, recommendation engines, image processing, market research, customer segmentation, and other problem statements can all be clustered. However, for this research, I'll be concentrating on how clustering is used to geospatial data.

articleTitle: A Survey on the security of IoT communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: One of the technologies that have gained the most traction over the past ten years in a variety of applications is the Internet of Things (IoT). For communication, processing, computing, and monitoring of various systems, the smart items are connected via wired or wireless technology. The items are diverse and have minimal memory and processing power. Implementing IoT systems raises security and privacy concerns because IoT devices are not compatible with traditional security protocols. The authors of this study began by providing an overview of IoT technology and subsequently explaining the means of achieving secure communication. This study examines current protocols and some Lightweight Cryptographic protocols to deal with some of the major problems of IoT. Protocols like Elliptic Curve Cryptography, Simon, Speck, and AES have been discussed along with others.

articleTitle: Poignant ground target recognition with Smooth Pseudo Wigner-Ville Distribution by Analysis of Time-Frequency Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Humans have had the ability to recognise items for hundreds of years, possibly even since they first appeared on Earth. All of the senses sight, smell, hearing, taste, and touch play a role in helping humans determine what is in their immediate vicinity. In order to integrate and make sense of the information picked up by the senses, the brain receives signals from those organs. Repetition of an experience has been shown to improve cognition. The learned knowledge is put to use in a wide variety of ways, from the mundane to the crucial, such as in the areas of security, surveillance, traffic monitoring, and so on. Human senses are limited to a relatively small range, and it could be dangerous or even fatal to work in some settings. This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of the many time- frequency methods now in use for finding targets. Furthermore, a unique method for detecting targets utilising an improved time-frequency representation of the seismic data is outlined in this research paper. When compared to solely time-domain or frequency-domain methods, time-frequency domain analyses do better. Because traditional time domain and frequency domain analysis methods only reveal one aspect of a signal at a time, time-frequency methods reveal both aspects at once.

articleTitle: Creation of Malwares and their Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: 979-8-3503-3802-7/23/$31.00 ©2023 IEEEUse of Malwares (Malicious Softwares) for Malicious purposes is a Cybercrime. Hackers could perform such attacks using different types of Malwares like Virus, worms, Trojan, Ransomware, Adware, Spywares (Keylogger), etc. Here, we have shown how such malwares are created and what is the procedure for effective implementation of Malwares. With effective implementation of such attacks Hackers could affect the Victims in numerous ways as Mentally, Economically, socially etc. Hackers could steal the confidential Credentials, destruct important files, get remote access of Victim’s system, etc. We have also shown how we can detect the malwares using their hash value i.e., digital signatures through Machine Learning Algorithms i.e., Deep Neural Network. We will also learn ways in which we can classify b/w Malwares and Benign (Authentic Softwares).

articleTitle: Survey on Different Techniques of Medical Image Watermarking to Ascertain Authenticity and Ownership
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The aim of medical image watermarking is to preserve the integrity of a medical image after embedding the required data. With the evolution of the internet in almost every domain of life, telemedicine is a word that has gained popularity in the last four to five years. This article provides an overview of the research that are carried out on medical image watermarking techniques in the last several years. To carry out this survey, research papers on different techniques for medical image watermarking have been studied from Google Scholar, ACM, IEEE, etc. 89% of the data is considered from reputed journals, and the rest of the papers are from different conferences, and book chapters. This article describes the comparison between various techniques used for medical image watermarking. It helps out in identifying the gaps between the different techniques so that a naive approach can be designed to get better results.

articleTitle: Blockchain: A Review Study of Protocols and Enterprise Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Buying and selling goods and services online is in vogue these days which involves business transactions conducted online. All this needs the security of the parties involved in the transaction against tampering, fraud, and cybercrime. A blockchain is a global decentralized ledger for maintaining the records of cryptocurrency transactions. Blocks, in a blockchain, store the pieces of information about the transactions and the participants. Blocks also store cryptographic codes known as hashes for identification purposes. When a block has some information, it is then added to the blockchain. But before the addition, the transactions must be validated. All the participants settle upon a common consensus algorithm for the addition of the block. These consensuses can either be proof-based consensus or enterprise-based consensus. In the proof-based consensus, the nodes have to provide the other participants with proofs according to t the protocol being followed. In the enterprise- based consensus, the participants chose their trusted delegates and these delegates work in the blockchain for the nodes which have chosen them. The blockchain may perform better if a suitable consensus mechanism is chosen. The suitability of a consensus mechanism varies from application to application. This paper provides a review of the most popular consensus models used in the blockchain environment.

articleTitle: Routing of Vehicular IoT Networks based on various routing Metrics, Characteristics, and Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: The use of the Vehicular Internet of Things (VIoT) has been rapidly increasing in recent years, which has led to the development of various routing protocols to facilitate communication among vehicles. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art routing metrics, characteristics, and properties used in VIoT networks. We examine different types of routing protocols, including geographic, position-based, and topology-based. We also investigate various factors affecting the performance of these protocols, such as the mobility patterns of vehicles, network topology, and energy consumption. Furthermore, we compare and contrast the advantages and disadvantages of different routing protocols in terms of their suitability for different types of VIoT applications. Finally, we identify several open research issues and challenges that need to be addressed in future VIoT routing research. This review paper provides a valuable reference for researchers and practitioners working on VIoT networks and can help them select an appropriate routing protocol for their specific applications.

articleTitle: Analyzing Frauds in Banking Sector and Impact of Internet Banking on Its Customers: A Case Study of Bank of Maharashtra
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computational Intelligence, Communication Technology and Networking (CICTN)
abstract: Banking fraud became an important issue in India as there were several examples of such misconduct within recent years. This research aims to identify frauds in Indian banking sector along with impact of internet banking on consumers with particular focus on bank of Maharashtra. In the introductory part of the paper, number of fraud activities in Indian banking sector along with its relevance are discussed including significance of internet banking in today’s world. In the literature review part, two themes are selected and analysed which are fraud cases in Indian banking industry and evolution of internet banking in India. For both these themes, data collected from previous studies and presented with critical evaluation. The research methodology section has included research philosophy, research approach, research design as well as methods & sources. Pragmatist research philosophy, inductive research approach and descriptive research design are selected for this particular study. The sources mentioned in the methods & sources section from which the selected articles and publications are gathered. The results and discussion section has mentioned different fraud cases of Bank of Maharashtra (BoM) including details of those cases. Moreover, the evolution of internet banking and BoM’s approach to implement internet banking are discussed in the next part of the results and discussion. Finally, the major reasons of frauds in Indian banking sector are concluded in the paper along with future scope of the research. At last, several strategic recommendations for government and banking institutions are presented, introducing which can help to deal with fraudulent activities through more appropriate way.
